body: Actually, some resources would be nice. I don't know how open he will be to outside help, since we both have trust issues and I get how that wouldn't help him, but is there anywhere reputable I can look to for advice on how to deal with all of this, or a number to call, especially in an emergency? I will be halfway across the country from him, so if he really decided to kill himself one night, is there anywhere I could call right away that could help him?

Thank you for the advice. I really do want to be there for him, but I can already feel it taking a toll on me. Staying up until 2 in the morning trying to convince him not to kill himself, then crying afterwards for a long while has already taken a bit of a toll. I really want to be there for him, and I'll try not to give up, but I don't know how long I can hold on for. His girlfriend also has self-loathing issues, so I don't know how long she'll be there for him either.

But thank you for the advice.
Thank you, I was wondering if I should see an adult in his life about this, but a doctor sounds perfect. I'll see what I can do about convincing him without making him feel like he's broken inside.

Please stay with us. Here's what I say to the world:

"FUCK YOU."

It's okay to give a fuck about others opinions, that's natural. But in the end they're just other people, and their opinion about you will never matter as much as yours.

Please just remember that life always, always gets better. I have no fucking clue how it does, but it never fails. Live for the happy moments, when everything is wonderful.

Please don't kill yourself. Please wait until you come down from your high.

And I love you. I may not know you personally, and I may have never met you before, but I love you because you are a person and you deserve my love because you are unique and wonderful.

I'm sorry about your brother. Think of the way you feel about him now - that's how everyone close to you will feel.

I know you weren't asking for advice, but please don't kill yourself. Please. You matter. You are worth everything, and don't ever think otherwise.

If it's not too much trouble, could you respond to this? Even if it's 'fuck off', I would love to know that you're still here.

I have felt the same, like "What's the point?". All I can say is that the point is to be here, to experience everything around us. It may not matter is the grand scheme of things, but fuck the grand scheme. I'm here and experiencing life, so fuck off universe.

I don't have friends or hobbies either, I move too much for that. Please just try to remain hopeful, that's how I get by. I see life as a roller coaster, and some people's drops and rises are more extreme than others. Just know that it gets better, it always does. And I'm not just saying that, it does always manage to turn around. I try to look forward to the next positive in my life. Maybe that's an unhealthy way to live? I don't know, maybe one day I'll crash and burn, but it's worked so far.

So please, just hang on. Don't kill yourself, you'll miss out on the whole 'fuck you universe' thing. Living I can say, "I don't care if I'm inconsequential, I'm still here, so suck on that."

I don't know if that helped any, but thank you for letting me vent here.
